This misc.appeal, under section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, has been filed against the award dated 22.04.2019 passed by Member MACT (Bench Court), Jatara, District Tikamgarh in Claim Case No.100047/2016.

The present appeal has been filed by the owner of the offending vehicle.

It is submitted by the counsel for the appellant that although the motorcycle was registered in the name of the appellant,
but he had already alienated the same, therefore, he is not liable to pay compensation.
3. Considered the submission made by the counsel for the appellant.
4. The grounds raised by the appellant is no more resintegra.

5. The Supreme Court in the case of Navin Kumar Vs. Vijay Kumar and others, reported in (2018) 3 SCC 1, has held that the person in whose name the motor vehicle stands registered would be treated as owner of the vehicle for the purpose of Motor Vehicle Act.

entities.text: Navin Kumar Vs. Vijay Kumar and others, reported in (2018) 3 SCC 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Only where a person is a minor,
the guardian of that minor would be treated as owner and where a motor vehicle is subject to an agreement of hire purchase, lease or hypothecation or is under requisition, the person in possession of vehicle under that agreement or under requisition is treated as owner.

Accordingly, it was held that the registered owner would be treated as owner of the vehicle for the purpose of Motor Vehicles Act irrespective of the fact as to whether he has transferred or sold his vehicle to any other person and would not stand absolve of his liability under the said Act.
It was also held that to hold otherwise would be to defeat the salutary object and purpose of the Motor Vehicles Act.

6. Accordingly, this Court is of the considered opinion that since the appellant is the registered owner of the vehicle in question, therefore, he has been rightly saddled with the liability to pay the compensation amount.

7. As no perversity could be pointed out by the counsel for the appellant, therefore the award dated 22.04.2019 passed by Member MACT (Bench Court), Jatara, District Tikamgarh in Claim Case No.100047/2016 is hereby affirmed.
8. The appeal fails and is hereby dismissed.

(G.S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE TG /-
